important_factors: Normal forecast demand over the 28-day planning horizon is 1680 units.
Current usable inventory is 600 units with no open purchase orders, projecting stockouts starting 2026-09-27 and total unmet demand of 1080 units if no action is taken.
Buyer confirmed the unconfirmed 500-unit corporate bulk order should be excluded from purchasing decisions.
To satisfy 1680 units of forecast demand and maintain 200 units of safety stock, net requirement is 1280 units, rounding to 1300 units given SUP-A pack size of 100.
SUP-A purchase order of 1300 units costs $11,700.00, arrives 2026-09-22, fully prevents shortages, and leaves 220 units (3.7 days cover) ending inventory within max cover limits.
args.rationale: The recommended order of 1300 units from SUP-A arriving on 2026-09-22 covers normal forecast demand without incorporating the unconfirmed 500-unit corporate bulk order, in accordance with buyer instructions. Without an order, inventory of 600 units exhausts by 2026-09-27, causing 1080 units of unmet demand. Ordering 1300 units (1280 required net requirement rounded up to SUP-A's 100-unit pack size) costs $11,700.00, eliminates all stockouts, maintains safety stock (200 units), and results in 220 units of closing stock (3.7 days cover), meeting all operational constraints.
